rationale: While the document explicitly states Spotify retains ownership and grants only a 'revocable licence,' it obscures the practical implications through legal complexity. The most aggressive elements are the mandatory arbitration clause (US users) with class action waiver, unilateral termination rights, persistent no-refund policy, and unlimited content modification without notice.
